{"id":1959283194,"question_id":3849,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1774468623,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"133 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1959283194/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Equal Sum Grid Partition I","memory":"200.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n\n    bool canPartitionGrid(vector<vector<int>>& grid) {\n        int n = grid.size();\n        int m = grid[0].size();\n\n        bool ans = false;\n        ll totalsum = 0;\n\n        vector<vector<ll>>rowpref(n , vector<ll>(m , 0));\n        vector<vector<ll>>colpref(n , vector<ll>(m , 0));\n\n        for(auto it : grid) for(auto x : it) totalsum += x;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++) rowpref[i][0] = grid[i][0];\n        for(int j = 0 ; j<m ; j++) colpref[0][j] = grid[0][j];\n\n        for(int j = 1 ; j<m ; j++)\n        {\n            for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++) rowpref[i][j] = rowpref[i][j-1] + grid[i][j];\n        }\n\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0 ; j<m ; j++) colpref[i][j] = colpref[i-1][j] + grid[i][j];\n        }\n\n        ll upsum = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            ll downsum = totalsum - upsum;\n            if(downsum == upsum) \n            {\n                ans = true;\n                break;\n            }\n            upsum += rowpref[i][m-1];\n        }\n\n        ll leftsum = 0;\n        for(int j = 0 ; j<m ; j++)\n        {\n            ll rightsum = totalsum - leftsum;\n            if(rightsum == leftsum) \n            {\n                ans = true;\n                break;\n            }\n            leftsum += colpref[n-1][j];\n        }\n\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"equal-sum-grid-partition-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1867}
